text.NARRATIVE: Beginning a new game at the title screen

text.SYSTEM: In a time unknown, only a prophecy keeps hope alive in people's hearts: "When darkness veils the world, the King of Light shall come."
Now, four brave warriors begin their journey, prepared to fight. What awaits the four, however, they do not know.

text.NARRATIVE: The scene fades in from black to Noctis Lucis Caelum dressed in the Kingly Raiment, "the clothing of the Chosen King" as it's described; his face illuminated by flames, he wipes sweat from his brow with the back of his sleeve; he's grunting from the intense heat sweltering around him; after a moment longer, he charges forward to face the demonic-looking Ifrit, who sits upon a throne of bones looking bored; other young men are already attacking the god of fire; as Noctis nears Ifrit, a pillar of flame erupts from the air in front of the fiery entity, enveloping Noctis; the royal protagonist is launched away, landing on his back with sections of his clothing on fire; Noctis's friend, Prompto Argentum, gets down on his knees beside Noctis, and quickly pats out the flames with his hands

text.Prompto: Noct! Hang in there, buddy!
Stay down. We'll keep him busy.

text.NARRATIVE: Prompto rejoins the battle; Noctis gets back to his feet; once he does so, another voice calls out to him: that of another close friend and retainer, Ignis Scientia, who is kneeling behind cover near Ifrit's throne

text.Ignis: Noct! Over here!

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis begins to go toward Ignis, but is moving slowly due to his wounds

text.Ignis: Quickly, before he strikes again!

text.NARRATIVE: Suddenly, Noctis is tackled from behind by a third friend — self-appointed Shield of the King, Gladiolus Amicitia — and pulled into cover where Ignis is; Prompto joins the other three within a second

text.Prompto: Here it comes!

text.NARRATIVE: Another pillar of flame from Ifrit washes around the four as they huddle together and use their cover for protection; when the flames pass, Prompto and Gladiolus immediately break from cover and charge at Ifrit

text.Prompto: Got your back!

text.NARRATIVE: Ignis stands and holds out a curative item to heal Noctis

text.Ignis: Here you go

text.NARRATIVE: The heir to the throne of Lucis rises once more and continues the charge alongside his friends
The screen fades out to white

An establishing shot of Insomnia is shown; the Wall that has protected the city for generations shimmers across the cityscape; the scene cuts to the throne room of the Citadel; a younger Noctis, Prompto, Ignis and Gladiolus stand before King Regis — Noctis's father

text.Regis: The decreed hour is come. Set forth with my blessing, Prince Noctis.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis bows

text.Regis: Take your leave, and go in the grace of the gods.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis straightens back up

Noctis turns and walks past his friends, who look startled; confused, they quickly turn back to the king and bow before setting off after Noctis; Regis looks unhappy with the proceedings; the scene transitions to the steps of the Citadel; Noctis and the others are descending toward a car where Cor Leonis stands awaiting them

text.Prompto: Well, princes will be princes.

text.Ignis: So much for royal protocol.

text.Gladiolus: Not like you had to deliver a formal address...

text.NARRATIVE: A voice suddenly calls out from behind them

Noctis stops and turns; his father is at the top of the steps, accompanied by Captain Drautos; despite his braced leg and dependence on a walking stick, Regis begins descending the steps to catch up to Noctis
Noctis walks back up some steps to meet his dad halfway

text.Regis: I fear I have left too much unsaid. You place a great burden on those who would bear with you.

text.NARRATIVE: Regis looks at Noctis's friends and begins to address them

text.Regis: I ask not that you guide my wayward son, merely that you remain at his side.

text.NARRATIVE: Ignis bows

text.Ignis: Indeed, Your Grace.

text.Gladiolus: We'll see the prince to Altissia if it's the last thing we see.

text.Prompto: Yeah, what he said.

text.Noctis: Hate to break this up, but Cor's got the motor running.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis begins walking away
Noctis stops once more and turns

text.Regis: Do mind your manners around your charming bride-to-be.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis walks back to Regis and bows with a deliberately exaggerated flourish

text.Noctis: Your Majesty, as well. Try to mind yours around our esteemed guests from Niflheim.

text.Regis: You have no cause for concern.
Take heed. Once you set forth, you cannot turn back.
I need only know that you are ready to leave home behind.

text.Noctis: Don't know about you, but I'm ready as I'll ever be.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis turns to leave once again; the king again interrupts his doing so

text.Regis: Take care on the long road.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis stops once more and turns; Regis continues speaking as he walks to Noctis again

text.Regis: Wheresoever you should go, the line of Lucis goes with you.

text.NARRATIVE: Regis puts his left hand on Noctis's right shoulder
The scene fades to black

text.SYSTEM: Prince Noctis Lucis Caelum sets forth from his homeland with his three-man retinue in tow. His destination: Altissia, capital of Accordo, where he will formalize the union of states through his marriage to Lady Lunafreya of the imperial province of Tenebrae.

text.NARRATIVE: The scene fades in onto a highway; a car is cruising down the road; in the road ahead of the car sits Noctis behind a large, fancy broken-down car; Prompto is on his back a couple of feet away; Gladio is standing beside the car and tries to wave down the approaching vehicle; Ignis is behind the wheel of their broken-down car, the Regalia; the civilian car approaching them just goes around them, honks a couple of times as if in annoyance, and continues on down the highway; Noctis yawns

text.Gladiolus: I think we can forget about hitching our way there... Thought people were friendly outside the city.

text.Ignis: You can only go so far on the kindness of strangers.

text.Gladiolus: Just gonna have to push her all the way.

text.Prompto: I've already pushed myself... to the brink of death.

text.NARRATIVE: Gladio smacks Noct on the back to get his attention and walks over to Prompto

text.Gladiolus: Oh, get up.

text.NARRATIVE: Gladio kicks Prompto's foot

text.Gladiolus: C'mon, car isn't gonna move itself.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct and Prompto get up

text.Prompto: Sheesh
I thought thecar was supposed to move us.

text.NARRATIVE: Gladio gets his hands in position on the back of the Regalia while Noctis and Prompto get in place on either side of the car

text.Gladiolus: Can it. Ready...

text.NARRATIVE: Noct and Prompto groan

text.Gladiolus: Steady... Push!

text.NARRATIVE: The Chocobros resume their journey the hard way; "Stand by Me," performed by Florence + the Machine, begins to play; their vehicle being large and heavy, progress is slow

text.Gladiolus: Not exactly a fairy tale beginning, huh, Prince Noctis?

text.Ignis: We let ourselves get carried away.

text.Prompto: Look, these things happen!

text.Gladiolus: Let's just hope this isn't some omen.
What?
All by myself?

text.Prompto: You won't even notice if we just let go.

text.Gladiolus: Prompto, don't even think about it.

text.Ignis: Save some breath for pushing.

text.Gladiolus: Nuh-uh! We just switched back there!

text.Prompto: And it's my turn, Noct.

text.Ignis: His "turn."

text.Prompto: My hands are killing me.

text.Gladiolus: You rather I kill you with mine?

text.Prompto: Easy there, tough guy.

text.Ignis: Only a busy signal.

text.Prompto: Hold the phone—is it just me, or was it supposed to be way closer?

text.Ignis: I assure you the map is correct.

text.Noctis: The map said Hammerhead was right there.

text.Prompto: Literally next door.

text.Gladiolus: Looks that way on a map of the world.

text.NARRATIVE: The four are quiet for a moment as they continue struggling to make their way

text.Noctis: The world's a big old place.

text.Ignis: Filled with wonders.

text.Prompto: Tell that to my legs

text.NARRATIVE: The camera pans up high above them, settling on the landscape and horizon ahead; an outpost is visible a mile or two down the highway; the Final Fantasy XV title card appears; the scene fades to black

The scene fades in on the large Hammerhead sign, then slowly pans down to the Chocobros and the car; Prompto is laying on the ground exhausted; the legs of a young woman come into view as she approaches the Regalia; taking notice of her, Prompto quickly gets back up

text.Cindy: Hey there, y'all kept a girl waitin'!

text.NARRATIVE: She looks around

text.Cindy: Now, which one's the prince?

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis stands up into view from the other side of the Regalia

text.Cindy: Aha! Hello, Your Highness. Congrats on your wedding!
Lady Lunafreya's groom-to-be, here in Hammerhead.

text.Ignis: Apologies for taking so long.

text.Cindy: You'd best save your apologies for Paw-paw.

text.Gladiolus: Well, that makes you...

text.Cindy: Cindy—Cid's grease-monkey granddaughter.

text.NARRATIVE: Cid suddenly shouts out to her

text.Cid: Roll ‘er in while I'm still young!

text.NARRATIVE: Cindy's grandfather comes walking up to the Regalia now

text.Cid: Didn't yer daddy tell ya? She's a custom classic, not some beat-up ol' clunker.

text.NARRATIVE: Cid looks the car over, then looks at Noctis

text.Cid: Prince Noctis.
"Prince." Like they took your old man and kicked the dignity out of him.

text.NARRATIVE: Cid resumes inspecting the Regalia

text.Cid: You got a long way to go, son. And that slack jaw's gettin' you nowhere fast. She's gonna take a while. Y'all get her in and run along.

text.NARRATIVE: Cid walks off; Cindy looks after him and sighs before turning back to the others

text.Cindy: Y'all heard him! Let's get movin'. Right this way.

text.NARRATIVE: Cindy motions for the others to follow her and walks off; the scene now transitions to the Chocobros standing outside the garage at Hammerhead, the Regalia inside being fixed; Cindy stands a few feet away

text.Ignis: And now we play the waiting game.

text.Prompto: Never liked that game.

text.Noctis: Never any good at it, either.

CHOICE.Cindy: Oh! Hey there! Prince!

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Note by Glenn Morrow: When Luna says "Only the True King, anointed by the Crystal, can purge our star of its scourge," what she refers to as "star" is 星 (i.e. hoshi) in Japanese; the word used for celestial bodies in general. It can mean "star," but can also refer to planets — and, indeed, is not only what everyone in FFVII refers to that game's planet by, but also what FFXV's Lore Guide from the game's opening tutorial explains the word to mean in this game

CHOICE.SYSTEM: In the Japanese version of FFXV, the segment of the Lore Guide entitled "The Six and the Oracle" ends with an additional line that says ちなみに、これらの話題でいう「星」は「世界」の意です — "By the way, ‘star' in these topics means ‘world.'" This either became "star" in the official English localization due to an error in translation or, as is more likely, a deliberate choice on the part of the localization to give some linguistic flair to the game's dialogue.

Click here for a screenshot or here for a video showing this segment of the Lore Guide in the Japanese version, and for further reference, this is Luna's line above in Japanese: クリスタルから力を得た真の王だけが星を脅かす敵を　倒すことができるのです]

Yeah?

text.Noctis: Yeah, let's run in and ride off.

text.Ignis: They are remnants of the Old War, and the imperial army has availed itself of the added protection. Entry will not be easy.

text.SYSTEM: Make camp at Sothmocke Haven and devise an infiltration strategy.

text.Ignis: A dark one, as it were. A frontal assault would leave us exposed. But, if we move under cover of night, we might be able to infiltrate the base unnoticed.
We learn all we can about the base's design and narrow down the Regalia's location. I'll analyze what intelligence we have available to find us a way in.

text.Prompto: Alright! We're gonna get our wheels back!

text.NARRATIVE: A prompt appears saying "Noctis must retrieve the Regalia before dawn. Begin the operation?" and asking the player to select either "Yes" or "No"

CHOICE.SYSTEM: Undaunted by the empire's imposing technology, Noctis and his retinue risk everything to break inside Aracheole Stronghold and recover the stolen Regalia.

CHOICE.Gladiolus: Take cover.

CHOICE.Ignis: Magitek armor.

text.Noctis: This is the might of the Six...

text.Prompto: Dude... that... was... hardcore!

text.Prompto: Piece of cake, huh?

text.Ignis: It seems a bit flippant.

text.Gladiolus: Why not go for something a little more epic?

text.Prompto: Because I thought of it first, so that's the name. "Bust-a-base"—get used to it.

text.Prompto: Guys?

text.Ravus: Long has it been, Noctis.
You receive the Storm's blessing. And yet, you know nothing of the consequences.

text.NARRATIVE: Ravus raises the point of his sword to Noctis's throat

text.Gladiolus: Watch it.

text.Ravus: Be still. All of you.

text.Prompto: Not good.

text.Ravus: I do not serve. I command!

text.NARRATIVE: Ravus shoves Noctis backward; Gladio gets between them

text.Ravus: The king's sworn shield.

text.Gladiolus: You better believe it.

text.Ravus: A weak shield protects naught.

text.NARRATIVE: Ravus slowly raises his sword above his head, then brings it down fiercely; Gladio briefly blocks it with his own sword before Ravus parries the weapon away and slams the pommel of his sword into Gladio's chest, sending him flying into the side of the Regalia; Prompto runs to check on Gladio while Noct gets between them and Ravus

Beneath the Cape Caem Light in the south of Cleigne lies an underground harbor. It has long served the Lucian royalty, and even now, a vessel once owned by King Regis lies at anchor there. Following in his father's footsteps, Noctis heads for the ship.

After Noctis fights his way through several more magitek troopers, he sees Leviathan looming above, speaking to Lunafreya

text.Leviathan: What does a lowly, ephemeral speck know of All Creation!?

text.NARRATIVE: Leviathan swings her body into the upper portion of the altar Lunafreya stands upon, breaking the upper stonework off and sending it into the sea in pieces

text.Luna: I know what you must know—that the King of Kings is to drive the darkness from our star.

text.NARRATIVE: Note by Glenn Morrow: When Luna says "I know what you must know—that the King of Kings is to drive the darkness from our star," what she refers to as "star" is 星 (i.e. hoshi) in Japanese; the word used for celestial bodies in general. It can mean "star," but can also refer to planets — and, indeed, is not only what everyone in FFVII refers to that game's planet by, but also what FFXV's Lore Guide from the game's opening tutorial explains the word to mean in this game

text.SYSTEM: In the Japanese version of FFXV, the segment of the Lore Guide entitled "The Six and the Oracle" ends with an additional line that says ちなみに、これらの話題でいう「星」は「世界」の意です — "By the way, ‘star' in these topics means ‘world.'" This either became "star" in the official English localization due to an error in translation or, as is more likely, a deliberate choice on the part of the localization to give some linguistic flair to the game's dialogue.

Click here for a screenshot or here for a video showing this segment of the Lore Guide in the Japanese version, and for further reference, this is Luna's line above in Japanese: 聖石に選ばれし王は　それはおまえも承知であろう]

text.NARRATIVE: Leviathan roars and launches one of her water coil copies at Lunafreya, knocking the Oracle to her knees, leaving her bruised and her dress torn; Lunafreya uses her trident to remain propped up; she coughs, then stands once more

text.Ardyn: How sweet... But please, Lady Lunafreya, you first.

text.NARRATIVE: Ardyn gives her a mocking half bow before departing into his ship; it flies away; Lunafreya looks over to Noctis, who still hasn't moved; she grabs her trident, raises it, and begins channeling a yellow column of light from it; a similar column descends on Noctis as other such columns arise from the royal tombs across Eos; Noctis slowly rises into the air as spectral currents of blue and yellow energy swirl around him; he and Lunafreya briefly make eye contact as her trident turns to one of the energy swirls and flies to Noctis; all the swirls of energy suddenly converge on him and leave him flying in the air, surrounded by spectral images of the royal arms; he faces off against Leviathan once again, now fully empowered by his ancestors; he unleashes a devastating salvo of energy weapons on her before severing one of her fins with the Oracle's trident; Noctis lands one powerful blow after another, even breaking off two of the sea goddess's three horns; finally, he delivers an explosive attack with energy forms of his ancestors' weapons before conjuring the trident once more and jamming it into Leviathan's neck, then using it to cut her open from neck to where her body touches the surface of the sea; water sprays from her massive wound; the screen briefly fades to black before transitioning to an exhausted Noctis slowly falling to the ground near Lunafreya
He gently lands on his back a few feet from her; he's unconscious; she crawls over to him and puts her forehead against his; yellow light begins to emanate from them

text.Luna: Blessed Stars of light and life...

text.NARRATIVE: Leviathan roars in pain and fury; seeing this, Lunafreya cradles Noctis in her arms; suddenly, Titan emerges from the sea in front of the serpentine deity; Titan punches his fist into the sea directly in front of Leviathan, sending up columns of earth that engulf the other god; the wall of water Leviathan had raised begins to collapse, along with the pillars of earth Titan caused to emerge; all around Lunafreya and Noctis is falling water and crumbling rock; the screen fades to white; when it fades in again, Noctis as a child is laying asleep in a field of sylleblossoms; there is no proper sky; it is just a white void; Lunafreya calls to him

text.Luna: Noctis.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct awakens and sees Lunafreya, as he knew when she was a child, striding toward him
Noct rises to his knees

text.Luna: So, you found your way here.
A chance to see you once more... Who would have thought?

text.NARRATIVE: She turns away; Noctis gets to his feet

text.Noctis: What do you mean? Why wouldn't you see me?

text.NARRATIVE: She turns back to him

text.Luna: Because my prayers have been answered. My calling fulfilled.

text.Noctis: But... that doesn't have to come between us.

text.NARRATIVE: Luna steps closer to him and bends down to look him in the eyes

text.Luna: You are the One, Noctis. The Stars shine for you now. That which is yours by right shall be restored to you.

text.NARRATIVE: She walks a few steps away, then turns back to look at him

text.Luna: Do you remember the flowers of Tenebrae? It seems so long ago. You'll find they await you still, blooming from hill to vale.

text.NARRATIVE: She is silent for a long moment, then solemnly shakes her head; a strong wind suddenly picks up, blowing sylleblossoms about; Luna now looks as she did moments ago while Noctis still appears as a child

text.Luna: Would that I could join you... but this moment will have to be enough.

text.NARRATIVE: The field around Noctis begins discorporating into dark wisps

text.Noctis: It's not right... All I... All I wanted... was to save you.

text.NARRATIVE: As the dark wisps begin enveloping them, and what wasn't a sky begins to look like the sea, Lunafreya reaches down and plucks a sylleblossom

text.Luna: When the world falls down around you, and hope is lost, when you find yourself alone, amid a lightless place, look to the distance. Know that I am there, and that I watch over you always.

text.NARRATIVE: Lunafreya holds out the sylleblossom and releases it toward Noctis as she sinks into the mirk

text.Luna: Farewell, dear Noctis.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis's face is wracked with pain as he begins clawing at the sea to try to reach her; he shifts into his adult appearance as he does this; failing, he reaches his hands out to her as she disappears from view and the sylleblossom released to him suddenly disperses, revealing the Ring of the Lucii floating toward Noctis; his face still twisted with heartbreak, he closes his hands around the ring; the scene briefly fades to white before transitioning to Noctis awakening with a groan in a bed in Altissia; he slowly sits up to see Ignis sitting across the room from him in a chair facing the other way; Ignis turns his head as if looking at Noctis over his shoulder; he isn't, however

text.Ignis: Back with us?

text.Ignis: I'll tell the others... though it may take a bit.

text.NARRATIVE: Around the edges of the sunglasses Ignis is wearing, Noct can now see the scars framing his eyes; Noctis is startled

text.Ignis: A small sacrifice in the greater battle.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis is quiet for a moment
Ignis turns away and is silent for an equally long moment

text.Ignis: Umbra left that for you.

text.SYSTEM: Across the water and onto the rails, the royal retinue makes for Gralea, the imperial capital. Their objective: reclaiming the Crystal, that they might reclaim their homeland. However, the ring's weight proves too much for Noctis to bear.
Several weeks later...

text.Gladiolus: You're not "pushing onward"?
Fair enough.

text.NARRATIVE: They all board the train; none of them notice Ardyn standing down the platform from them, watching them; Ardyn boards the train; the train departs from Cartanica Station

text.SYSTEM: LeilaLucinia for providing screenshots of the exchange between Noctis and Camelia when selecting "Leave her hanging" during their negotiation scene

Ignis's resolve forces a reconciliation between Noctis and Gladiolus and restores harmony to the group. With renewed vigor, the four friends reboard the train and head for Tenebrae, home of the late Lady Lunafreya.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct and Ignis sit at a table in the dining car of the train

text.Ignis: Feels good to ride the rails.
Eager to drive once we're in Gralea?
We're fortunate to have the Regalia at all. We owe the first secretary our thanks.

text.Noctis: She'd get more thanks if she gave us a discount.

text.Ignis: Those transceivers are top-notch. I recall when the Hydraean raged— In the midst of the empire's retreat, one conspicuous craft remained behind: the chancellor's. The last thing I remember seeing was his ship, heading for the altar. I fell unconscious... and was powerless to stop him.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct makes a startled sound and leans into the aisle slightly to look past Ignis

text.Ignis: Is someone else there?

text.Noctis: Gladio—he just came back. Where did he go anyway?

text.Ignis: On a brief reconnaissance. Something caught my ear.

text.NARRATIVE: Gladio walks up to their table

text.Gladiolus: Hey captain, mission complete.

text.Ignis: Splendid.
Rumors of longer nights.

text.Gladiolus: They've been growing longer, day by day.

text.Ignis: There was talk of it back in Lucis, but recent days have shown an unseasonably sharp change. Should this trend continue, before long...

text.Gladiolus: Well, it's not out of the question. The empire's already slain half of the Six. No wonder the whole world's in disarray.

text.Ignis: And longer nights mean more daemons.

text.Gladiolus: Seen that with our own eyes.

text.Ignis: I happened to overhear a fellow passenger discussing this very same phenomenon.

text.Gladiolus: So he sent yours truly to seek 'em out.
Well, don't wanna keep 'em waiting.

text.Ignis: No, we don't. Back in a moment.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct sits in silence for a moment looking out the window; as the train begins to pass a snowy mountain range covered in mist, Prompto comes running by, then tries to stop and slips when he realizes he's passing Noctis

text.Prompto: Whoa! There you are, buddy! Did you see this? It's unreal!

text.Noctis: Yeah. Never seen anything like it. Doesn't make any sense.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct looks around the dining car and suddenly realizes that no one else is moving; everything is blanketed in grey and everyone is frozen in place; Prompto is missing; Noctis stands
Noctis suddenly hears Ardyn's voice behind him

text.Ardyn: It's a real mystery.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct turns to find Ardyn standing in the dining car

text.Ardyn: I'm not liking that snow cloud. Kind of gives me the chills. Like, who comes up with this stuff? I couldn't dream something like this if I tried. It's a wondrous world.

text.Noctis: The hell are you doing here!?

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis springs to punch Ardyn in the face, but he dodges

text.Ardyn: Whoa, what's going on!? Easy there, buddy. Didn't see that coming. You alright?

text.NARRATIVE: Noct conjures a sword and swings it at Ardyn, who steps back just out of range

text.Ardyn: Be careful there! Wait—is this for real?

text.NARRATIVE: "Ardyn" begins to run away; Noctis pursues him into the cabin car; Ardyn runs into one of the cabins and shuts the door; Noctis jerks the door open
Suddenly, Ardyn leaves over from behind Noctis

text.Ardyn: Uh... Noct?

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis swings around with his fist, hitting nothing but air; Ardyn has vanished again
Noctis runs to the next car, where he sees Ardyn backing away

text.Ardyn: C'mon, Noct. You're scaring me! Seriously, man, cut it out!

text.NARRATIVE: Ardyn passes to the next car, where Noctis continues to doggedly pursue him

text.Ardyn: It's not safe. Plus, you're causing a scene. Quit playing around, okay?

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis catches up to him and conjures a sword once again, which he immediately takes swing with, attempting to bisect Ardyn horizontally
Ardyn ducks the blade, then quickly scrambles to his feet, and runs toward the next car

text.Ardyn: Dude, are you seriously trying to kill me!?

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis follows him into the space between these two cars

text.Noctis: Why wouldn't I!? I've got you now.

text.NARRATIVE: Ardyn is barely able to stand, so out of breath is he; he's holding one hand out, trying to convince Noctis to stop

text.Noctis: What're you after, following me around this whole time? It's all YOUR fault—

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis puts his elbow against Ardyn's neck and shoves him against the door to the next car

text.Ardyn: What are you talking about? Do you really mean that, Noct?

text.NARRATIVE: A prompt appears to select either "Yeah" or "Maybe"

CHOICE.Noctis: Of course I do! You can't talk your way out of this!

CHOICE.Ardyn: You won't even let me! Noct, please. Can't we talk for a sec?
Yes! What good would it do me to hurt you!?
Noct, please. Can't we talk for a sec?

text.NARRATIVE: Suddenly, Noctis is thrown violently to the floor as the train's brakes bring it to a screeching halt

Note: The reason "Ardyn" is talking like Prompto throughout this scene is because the person Noct sees as Ardyn actually is Prompto; Ardyn is using his powers to swap appearances with Prompto, which continues into the next scene where Noctis thinks he's now talking to Prompto but is actually speaking with Ardyn

text.SYSTEM: Eusciello

The deserts of the western continent have long been littered with imperial armories and outposts. The slaying of the Glacian, however, gave birth to a paradoxical phenomenon: snow fields and sand dunes coexisting mere miles apart. Noctis and his friends would be wise to flee this treacherous terrain posthaste.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct comes to on the floor with "Prompto" awakening him

text.Prompto: Noct! Are you okay?

Wait—he's here? If he is, that would explain all this weird stuff happening. I bet he's behind the train stopping. Ignis and Gladio went up to inspect the engine room. I say the two of us go check out the rear.

text.NARRATIVE: Not runs back the way he had come while in pursuit of "Ardyn"; in the car before the cabin car, the train suddenly shakes and windows shatter all around; Noctis falls to the floor, but quickly gets back up

text.Prompto: Did they bomb us!? Noct, we have to protect the people!

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis runs onward into the cabin car, where a magitek trooper jumps through the glass and pursues several people; the civilians run past "Prompto" and Noctis

text.Prompto: Head to the next car!

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis destroys the magitek trooper

text.Prompto: So much for a safe ride. More of 'em might be on board. Let's check the rear!

text.Noctis: We need to get the train moving again.

text.Prompto: I'm sure Ignis and Gladio will come up with something.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis runs onward, moving through the dining car

text.Prompto: How bad do you think it is? Hope nobody got hurt.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis continues on through another cabin car, where the glass all shatters as yet another violent shake rocks the train; when he reaches the car past the passenger car after that, he's thrown back by an explosion that takes out the side of the car

text.Prompto: Man, the MTs can self-destruct.

text.NARRATIVE: A multitude of magitek troopers are visible through the twisted wreckage; they're either firing upon the train or trying to reach it

text.Prompto: Well then! We take the fight to them!

text.SYSTEM: Imperial shock troopers are attempting to blow up the train.
Take them down before they get too close.
If the train takes too much damage, the game is over.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis and Prompto head outside through the hole created when the side of the train car was blown open; visible in the distance is a massive pyramid-shaped flying fortress; many smaller imperial drop ships are emerging from the fortress and flying toward the train

text.Prompto: That thing's huge! We've got company!
Let the party begin!

text.NARRATIVE: "Prompto" and Noctis begin dismantling the magitek troopers

text.Prompto: What're the odds we'll win?
Oh, the fun never ends!

text.NARRATIVE: After the two destroy a great number of the magitek troopers, a number of imperial tanks in the area begin firing on the train

text.Prompto: Looks like they've rolled out the big guns!

text.SYSTEM: An imperial tank has also begun firing on the train.
Point-warp to the tank and destroy it before it shoots.
If the train takes too much damage, the game is over.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis point-warps to one of the tanks, rips open a hatch leading to some explosive cylinders, conjures a sword, shoves it through the cylinders, then point-warps to the safety of a water tower as the tank explodes; meanwhile, the train has begun moving again; Prompto's voice rings out

text.Prompto: C'mon, we're leaving!

text.NARRATIVE: "Prompto" is back on board the train; Noctis point-warps to the top of the train

text.Prompto: Look—they're hot on our tail! They're gonna blow us to bits!

text.Noctis: Not if we blow 'em up first!

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis takes out two more magitek troopers that had gotten on board

text.Prompto: How's that now?
Oh, now there's an idea.

text.SYSTEM: Imperial assault crafts have also begun firing on the train.
Point-warp to the ships and destroy them.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis point-warps to the inside of one of the ships, where he begins hacking the magitek troopers to bits

text.Noctis: Every single one of 'em's a bomber!

text.SYSTEM: Once inside, force the shock troopers to self-destruct, or use the turret to take down the four assault crafts. If the train takes too much damage, the game is over.

text.Noctis: That'll do it! Better head back down.

text.NARRATIVE: Down below, on top of the train, stand "Ardyn" and "Prompto," the former holding one of the latter's own guns on him; Prompto's hands appear to be up; Noct point-warps down to the train near them

Noct takes a swing at the gun "Ardyn" is holding, knocking it to the roof of the train, and then another swing at "Ardyn," causing him to fall backward off the train; at this point, Noctis becomes able to see that it is Prompto who is falling; so horrified is Noctis at the realization, he doesn't even look behind him to see Ardyn standing there, holding up one of Prompto's guns

text.Ardyn: How long were you in the dark?

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis turns to look at Ardyn but is left completely open to the blow to the back of his head that Ardyn administers with the butt of Prompto's gun; Noct falls to the roof of the train, unconscious

text.SYSTEM: Ardyn uses a stitch in time to switch appearances with PRompto, and tricks Noct into hurting his closest friend. Nevertheless, a king pushes ever onward, accepting the consequences, and never looking back.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis comes to, still laying on the roof of the train
He pulls out his cell phone and calls Ignis

text.Ignis: What's wrong?

text.Noctis: Ignis, you've gotta stop this thing! Prompto fell off the train. I pushed him—I mean, Ardyn made me. I don't know where he is, but we can't leave him!

text.Ignis: Stay calm, Noct. I'm as concerned for Prompto as you are, but stopping the train would endanger everyone onboard. We'd be sitting ducks for the daemons.
First, we drop the passengers off at Tenebrae. We'll be arriving shortly.

text.Ardyn: Given the chancellor's involvement, it's probable he's no longer where we left him. In any case, he may try to contact us. Let us wait and hope for now.

text.NARRATIVE: The train begins going through a mountain tunnel

text.Ignis: Can you make your way here? Gladio is with me.

text.Noctis: Are the two of you okay at least?

text.Ignis: Yes.

text.Noctis: Okay, on my way. I'll be there as soon as I take care of these stowaways!

text.NARRATIVE: The walls and ceiling of the tunnel are crawling with daemons, many of which begin converging on Noctis
Noctis fights through daemon after daemon as he makes his way toward the front car of the train

text.Noctis: Where do they keep coming from?

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis reaches the front car and realizes it's no longer broad daylight; night has begun to fall suddenly and swiftly beyond the end of the tunnel; however, the air also begins to fill with the crystals of light that accompany the appearance of a summoned god

text.Noctis: What!? No light at the end of the tunnel!?

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis takes notice of many large spider-like daemons hanging from the ceiling ahead of the train

The daemons drop onto the train, which emerges into the rapidly disappearing daylight; the train is being swarmed as it reaches Tenebrae; Fenestala Manor looms in the distance, but Noctis is about to face a potentially overwhelming horde; suddenly, Leviathan emerges from the valley below and begins unleashing its water coil copies at the daemons, knocking them loose and shattering even more windows; a water cyclone the sea god has kicked up sucks in the daemons as they are knocked off the train; having saved the train, the great serpent departs, but is at that moment Noctis realizes Fenestala Manor is burning
Having arrived at Tenebrae, Noct sits on the train platform along with the many other beleaguered passengers; Gladio and Ignis stand beside him; from behind Noct, he suddenly hears a familiar voice

text.Aranea: Well, look who's here.

text.Noctis: Aranea. Guess we've got you to thank for this mess?

text.Aranea: More to it than meets the eye. You wanna know who to thank? Come with me.

text.NARRATIVE: Slowly, Noct gets to his feet

CHOICE.Woman: Are you alright?

CHOICE.Old Man: Really did a number on me.

CHOICE.Woman: We ought to get you to a doctor. By the sound of it, we'll be departing for Altissia in a short while.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct and his two remaining companions walk along behind Aranea toward some imperial drop ships

text.Aranea: What did you do to your eyes?

text.Ignis: Oh, uh... Just a flesh wound.

text.Aranea: Can you see?

text.Ignis: I'm... afraid not.

text.Aranea: Wow. That sucks. It's a cruel world.

text.NARRATIVE: Aranea suddenly stops and looks at them

text.Aranea: Uh, wasn't there one more of you guys?

text.Gladiolus: We... lost track of him.

text.Aranea: Is he dead?
Then quit moping, keep hoping.

text.NARRATIVE: Aranea resumes walking

text.Aranea: And in the meantime, handle what's at hand.

text.Gladiolus: So if it's not you we thank...

text.Aranea: Thank the daemons, pawns of the imperial army.

text.Gladiolus: The army that you fight for.

text.Aranea: Fought for. My men and I are in the search and rescue business now.

text.Ignis: You mentioned being part of the relief effort. We have a favor to ask.

text.Aranea: Ask away.

text.Ignis: In light of what you've told us, we can't allow the other passengers to continue on.

text.Aranea: Sure, leave 'em to me... but, who's gonna drive the train?

text.Gladiolus: Now that you mention it, yeah. You know anyone?

text.Aranea: I do. In fact, I know two.

text.NARRATIVE: Aranea walks the trio up to two other familiar faces

text.Aranea: Your new engineers. Biggs and Wedge. No need to worry—they can take a lickin'.

text.Biggs: Only if we have to. What's all this about?

text.Aranea: Driving a train. To Gralea.
Well, who would you have me ask?

text.Gladiolus: Hey, really appreciate you going out of your way.

text.Aranea: Yeah. No sweat.

text.Biggs: We're happy to help. Can't say the climate will be as cooperative, though. Y'know?

The place is freezin'! Makes sense, what with the ice goddess's cold corpse lyin' around. It's a rather long ride, so I suggest you bundle up before we ship out. By the way, I bumped into a woman from the manor, used to serve House Fleuret. Must've gone off looking for ya. Said she had something important to discuss.

text.Noctis: With me? Guess I oughta find her, then.

CHOICE.Noctis: So, you've cut your ties with the empire?

CHOICE.Biggs: The only way we could help the people was by leaving the army. Lady A'd about had it with them as it were.
Nothing but daemons in the capital. Meanwhile, the Crystal's just sitting there. No one in the army signed up for this!
They're either lying quiet behind closed doors or lying dead. Your guess is as good as mine.

CHOICE.Aranea: The chancellor is running some circus. The high commander got the axe—literally, and the emperor's no more than a husk at this point. Everyone in charge is gone now. It's total chaos—all hell broke loose in the daemon labs.

CHOICE.Ignis: Elaborate.

CHOICE.Aranea: Unprogrammed MTs left to run amok... Same for the daemons we caught. And now they're everywhere.

CHOICE.Ignis: They emanate from the empire?

CHOICE.Aranea: Yeah, the capital's crawlin' with 'em. As if that wasn't bad enough, the bastards are stronger than ever now. It's gotten too far out of hand for the army to deal with. There's not enough daylight anymore to keep the daemons in one place.

CHOICE.Gladiolus: And so that's how they got here.

CHOICE.Aranea: Then there's the Crystal they stole ‘for the good of the people,' which never sees the light of day. A lot of good it's doing anyone now, locked away in the imperial fortress.

CHOICE.Ignis: If you intend to linger here a while, might I suggest you take a moment to speak with the people of the manor? I'm sure they'd relish the chance to share their tales of Lady Lunafreya.

CHOICE.Gladiolus: Better hear 'em while you can. We won't be coming back soon.

text.Maria: My word... Is that you, Prince Noctis?
Oh, blessed be the Stars. Just look at what a fine young man you've grown into. I am Maria, a retainer in service to House Fleuret. I doubt you'll remember me after these long years.

text.Noctis: I... uh... can't say I do.

text.Maria: Don't worry. Who I am is of little import—in light of what I wish to discuss. Lady Lunafreya risked everything to spirit the Ring of the Lucii away from the Citadel. Did she deliver it to you?

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis is silent for a moment

text.Maria: Stars above! My fears have been assuaged. Lord Ravus, too, will be overjoyed to hear this news.

text.NARRATIVE: Maria nods; the scene transitions to a flashback in Altissia of Lunafreya having difficulty sitting up straight in her chair due to the toll her toil is taking on her; Ravus's hands appear on her shoulders to help right her; she's trying to catch her breath; she opens her palm to look at the Ring of the Lucii; her hand is shaking; Ravus sees the ring and takes a step back

text.Luna: I beg of you... please... see the ring to Noctis on my behalf.

text.NARRATIVE: Ravus turns and takes a few steps away

text.Luna: Already... my flesh has begun to fail me.

text.Ravus: No, I cannot accept it.

text.NARRATIVE: Lunafreya's expression turns to surprise, then frustration; a tear falls down her face

text.Ravus: By your hand it must be done.

text.NARRATIVE: Ravus turns back to face her

text.Ravus: To deliver the ring and inspire the king is your calling. You mustn't fall.

text.Luna: But... I lack the strength to go on...

text.NARRATIVE: Ravus kneels in front of her, and takes her hands into his own

text.Ravus: Find it, Lunafreya. You have the will. Go to Noctis. Show him the truth of your heart.

text.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions back to the present

text.Maria: I understand you will go hence to the imperial capital.
Lord Ravus has King Regis's glaive in his safekeeping, and it was his wish to return it to you, my Prince. Though I imagine it will not be easy for you to find each other.

text.Noctis: I'll get it from him somehow.

text.Maria: I pray it shall be so.

CHOICE.Maria: I learned from Lord Ravus that poor Pryna also passed that tragic day, by Lady Lunafreya's side. Perhaps there is some solace that they could remain together to the end. Umbra must be distraught, having lost his mistress and dear friend.
May the stars watch over you, Prince Noctis.

CHOICE.Aranea: About the Crystal... Remember how I said it was locked away?

They really don't allow anyone near the thing. The emperor himself never got close to it. The lab rats had a theory that the Crystal posed some kind of... threat to the daemons. The way they see it, that's the reason the chancellor had the emperor go after it in the first place. Dunno, but that theory holds water in my book.
Certainly explains why the kings have always guarded the Crystal, and how they kept the daemons at bay. Long story short, we're stuck in this rut until you go and take back what's yours.

text.NARRATIVE: A young girl comes running up to him

text.Girl: Prince Noctis, were—were you excited to marry Lady Lunafreya? Because she was really excited to marry you! She looked so excited the day her dress arrived! She really loved you, Prince Noctis.

text.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions to a flashback of Lunafreya talking with Gentiana in Fenestala Manor

text.Gentiana: At first, the father had mourned the fate of his chosen son. Yet in Tenebrae, the two found solace. It was not the Oracle who assuaged their fears. But the girl... she holds... the true power.

text.Luna: I have little to offer a king, other than the voice afforded the Oracle. Nevertheless...

text.NARRATIVE: Luna turns to look at the wedding dress

text.Luna: And—I'm afraid he might find this foolish... But... to be together with Noctis again, even if only for a short while... It... would mean the world to me.

text.NARRATIVE: Luna turns back to Gentiana

text.Luna: I do not seek to guide him, merely to stand beside him.

text.NARRATIVE: Gentiana smiles and nods; the scene transitions back to the present

text.Girl: Lady Lunafreya worried she was burdening you with the wedding. That's not true, is it?

CHOICE.Girl: Lady Lunafreya was lucky to find a nice guy like you.

CHOICE.Man: Will we ever see the dawn again? What has become of our world?
It was such a beautiful place. If only Lady Lunafreya were still with us...
Let me go find you something to eat.

CHOICE.Old Man: No, it's fine. Don't worry about me. How could this happen?

CHOICE.Man: Took the words right out of my mouth.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The elderly man sighs

CHOICE.Man: You okay, Grandpa? They said we'll be leaving soon. Hang in there.

CHOICE.Old Man: Don't worry: I'll be fine as long as they get me back to Accordo.

CHOICE.Woman: It's been dark for so long.

CHOICE.Old Man: Looks like the night will never end.

CHOICE.Old Woman: How in the world could something like this happen?
Perhaps this is the way it ends.
That Aranea girl is an imperial, isn't she?
Yes, but she's not with the army. Not anymore, at least.
Perhaps it's for the best Lord Ravus never made it back here.
Promoted to high commander one day, executed for high treason the next.

CHOICE.Man: I swear I saw a giant serpent back there.
You too, huh? Good to know I'm not goin' crazy.
This has been one wild ride.
We should hop off before it gets any wilder.
I don't wanna keep going. Can't we go home?
I'll go and have a word with the conductor.
You don't think the soldiers here will hurt us, do you?
I certainly hope not.

CHOICE.Woman: I listened to Lady Lunafreya's address on the radio. To think she gave that speech in the very place she was to be wed... I can only imagine how she must have felt.
I can't believe my eyes. What do we do now? How could something like this happen? Is the capital okay?

CHOICE.Old Man: Lady Lunafreya once tended a garden filled with sylleblossoms, watering the flowers herself. Sadly, the whole field went up in flames. It's heartbreaking to see what's become of it.

CHOICE.Boy: So you're Lady Lunafreya's "fee-on-say," right? Wanna know something?
Everyone knows she liked pretty flowers, but you know what else she liked? Cool stickers. It has to be true!

CHOICE.Ignis: Is the manor badly damaged?

CHOICE.Gladiolus: It's seen better days. So have the civilians. They've been through a lot.

CHOICE.Ignis: And the chancellor's the one who put them through it.

CHOICE.Gladiolus: Put us through a hell of a lot, too. Never gets in our way, but he sure loves messing with us. Well, there's a good chance he got his hands on Prompto. Just hope he doesn't mess with him too bad.
Ravus didn't have it much better than Lady Lunafreya.

CHOICE.Ignis: Pity we never got the chance to talk things out. Hopefully His Majesty's glaive awaits us in the capital.

CHOICE.Gladiolus: Should be, as long as Ravus has it on his person. Just hope the chancellor isn't awaiting us, too. Still can't believe House Fleuret has reached the end of its family line.

CHOICE.Old Woman: It's rather strange. Lady Gentiana has not graced us with her presence as of late. Perhaps she has no reason to stay now that the Blood of the Oracle is no more. Like her, others will eventually leave, and the land of Tenebrae will be lost to memory.

CHOICE.Old Man: The empire has declared Lord Ravus a traitor and sentenced him to death. I believe the attack on the manor was further punishment.

CHOICE.Man: I guess we should give up on the capital.
Yeah, oughta find somewhere safer to hawk our wares.
Sounds like the lab in Gralea's a real mess. Wouldn't surprise me if it really is haunted.
Wonder where Emperor Iedolas went off to.
Somewhere six feet under—like the high commander.

CHOICE.Woman: Lady Lunafreya...
Take heart, everything will be alright.

CHOICE.Man: I don't see what good it does me to come here. I never even got to thank her for all that she's done.

CHOICE.Woman: Then show your thanks by praying for her safety.

CHOICE.Man: I'm gonna ask an imperial about it again later.

CHOICE.Woman: And I'll go with you when you do.

text.Biggs: Ready to depart. Just swapped out the damaged cars for some new ones. Give one of us a holler when you're ready to shove off, then.

text.Wedge: Dining car's open. If you need a break.

text.NARRATIVE: A prompt appears asking "Depart for Gralea?"; the player can select either "Yes" or "No"

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene briefly fades to black; when it fades back in, Aranea is standing in front of Noct, Ignis and Gladio

CHOICE.Aranea: Don't worry about the civilians. They're in my good hands. Can't say the same for you. Watch yourselves in the capital.

CHOICE.Ignis: We will.

CHOICE.Noctis: Thanks, Aranea. We'll see you around.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Gladio and Ignis turn and board the train; Noct turns and begins to follow, then stops, looking up as he takes notice of snow beginning to fall

CHOICE.Gladiolus: Get your ass on board.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: He, too, boards the train

CHOICE.SYSTEM: A frozen ravine where the fallen Shiva lies, a solitary railroad carved through its unforgiving snowscape. With Biggs and Wedge driving, the train makes its slow and steady way toward the imperial capital.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The three remaining Chocobros are sitting in the dining car, Ignis and Gladio at a table, Noctis at the bar by himself; Biggs addresses them over the loudspeaker

CHOICE.Biggs: Oi! Uh—attention all passengers! We're on our way to our final destination in the imperial capital. Enjoy the ride. I'll be in touch if anything comes up.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Biggs ceases his address

CHOICE.Gladiolus: Look at all that snow. No wonder it's so cold in here.

CHOICE.Ignis: We must be approaching the Glacian's cadaver.

CHOICE.Gladiolus: Won't be a blessing if all we got's a body.

CHOICE.Ignis: Let us hope we pass through the gorge without incident.

CHOICE.Gladiolus: It's what's after the gorge I'm worried about.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Noctis stands
A notification appears saying "Noctis is free to roam about until the train arrives."

CHOICE.Gladiolus: Once we get through Ghorovas, we're there.

CHOICE.Ignis: We've come quite a long way.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Gladio grunts

CHOICE.Gladiolus: It's depressing when it's always dark out.

CHOICE.Ignis: Still dark? Seems there's scarcely anything left of day.

CHOICE.Gladiolus: Still no word from Prompto.

CHOICE.Ignis: Let's hope he's safe.

text.NARRATIVE: Before long, Noctis's cell phone rings
He answers
He listens

text.Noctis: Okay. Thanks for letting us know.

text.NARRATIVE: Note by Glenn Morrow: If Noctis is in the dining car with Ignis and Gladio when the train arrives at the next story beat, he doesn't receive the phone call
The locomotive begins barreling through large chunks of ice that have formed over the tracks, causing the front of the train to start icing up; the train's brakes bring it screeching to a halt

text.Gladiolus: I wonder what it could be this time.

text.NARRATIVE: Biggs addresses them over the loudspeaker once more

text.Biggs: You may have noticed we've stopped. As for the cause... Outside, ya think?

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis begins to head outside

text.Gladiolus: Hope it's just a quick snow-shoveling job.

text.Ignis: Indeed.

text.NARRATIVE: Gladio and Ignis follow after Noct; outside, Noct has his arms wrapped around himself

text.Gladiolus: Better keep moving to stay warm.

text.Ignis: The Glacian did this.

text.Noctis: I think I can see her.

text.NARRATIVE: Indeed, Shiva's lifeless face can be seen in the snow beyond the tracks

text.Gladiolus: It's a shame. She's lying dead. Damn, it's cold!

text.Noctis: Let's clean up out here, warm up in there.

text.Gladiolus: Better make this snappy.

text.NARRATIVE: Suddenly, they're attacked by several daemons; after disposing of the creatures, Noct stands outside the train trying to catch his breath; from the doorway to get back onboard, Gladio is leaning out and calls to him

text.Gladiolus: Hey, Noct! You'd better get in here. Something's not right.

text.NARRATIVE: Gladio goes back inside

text.Gladiolus: C'mon, Iggy.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis begins to follow them inside; just as he's about to walk up the steps to get inside, he sees Ardyn walk past him, already inside the train
Noctis runs inside

text.Noctis: You! Hold it! That son of a bitch.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct follows Ardyn into the train car where Gladiolus and Ignis were headed to find the car filled with mist and cold air

Making his way into the next car, Noctis opens the door to be buffeted by snow and cold winds; he can make out Ardyn's silhouette at the other end of the car; wrapping his arms around himself, Noctis struggles through each step to keep advancing

text.Noctis: Stop! Stop, dammit! Where is he? Where's Prompto?

text.Ardyn: Oh, there you are! I'm worried about your friends. They've fallen and they can't get up. Why not lend them a hand?

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis manages to get a few feet from Ardyn. Beyond him, Noctis can see Ignis and Gladio on the floor being covered in ice

text.Ardyn: A coldness that can only be hers.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis falls to his knees; as his vision begins to blur, he takes notice of a woman in the doorway past Ignis and Gladio; it's Gentiana; Ardyn turns and realizes she's there as well; his expression momentarily becomes one of surprise, then nonchalance; Gentiana begins walking toward them

text.Ardyn: Ahh, the face you wore the day you—

text.NARRATIVE: Gentiana touches her pointer finger to her lips, then touches Ardyn's lips with it, instantly turning his entire body to ice; she then walks up to Noctis

text.Gentiana: Let it now be done... as promised to the Oracle.

text.NARRATIVE: Gentiana gestures widely with her arms and floats into the air before being obscured by a flash of blue and white light; as the light fades, the form of Shiva has taken Gentiana's place

text.Noctis: Gentiana—it's you. You're the Glacian. Wha—

text.Gentiana: O King of Kings, restore Light unto the world.

text.NARRATIVE: She raises her hands and conjures Lunafreya's trident; she hands it to Noctis; he leans forward and grasps it; the two are enveloped in another flash of light; a flashback of Lunafreya and Ravus in the field of sylleblossoms at Tenebrae is now shown; her back is to him

text.Ravus: Sister, cease this madness. That boy will never be King.

text.Luna: Noctis is chosen. It is ordained. You of all people should know.

text.Ravus: I know that you are throwing your life away!

text.NARRATIVE: Lunafreya turns and shouts back at her brother

text.Luna: That may be! But... it's my choice. If only...

text.NARRATIVE: Lunafreya begins to cry

text.Luna: If only I could... hear his voice once more... If we could laugh together as we did as children...

text.NARRATIVE: She grips her hands together and continues to cry as the flashback ends, fading back to Noctis on the train in the present; Gentiana is gone, as is the blizzard that was enveloping the train car

text.SYSTEM: Trident of the Oracle x 1
Mark of the Glacian x 1

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis walks up to the frozen Ardyn, conjures the Trident of the Oracle, and shatters the imperial chancellor's frozen body with Lunafreya's weapon
Noct then loses his balance and stumbles to his downed friends
They begin to stir

text.Gladiolus: The hell happened?

text.Noctis: Yeah. I saw the Glacian. It's okay, she's gone now. You guys check on our drivers.

text.Gladiolus: Got it.

text.NARRATIVE: Gladio turns to Ignis and places his hand on his shoulder

text.Gladiolus: You good?

text.Ignis: Yes, I'm fine. Let's go.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis remains on the floor as they leave; after they've left, he begins to see the spectral image of sylleblossom petals floating past his feet; as his eyes move up, he sees first her feet, then a spectral image of Lunafreya herself

Noct slowly rises to his feet and reaches out to Luna; she smiles at him; just as he's about to touch her, she vanishes; Noctis falls forward; as he sits back up, the last of the sylleblossom petals floats into his open palm; he clenches his fist around it and begins to cry

text.Noctis: It's so hard. Guess it was hard for you, too. I'm sorry I couldn't be there for you.

text.Shiva: Tales of the past and hopes for the future are manifest in the King of Kings. The Frostbearer's blessing shall be his.

text.NARRATIVE: A prompt asking "What should I ask her?" appears; the player can select "Ask about tales of the past," "Ask about hopes for the future" or "Nothing"

CHOICE.SYSTEM: Ask about tales of the past

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene briefly fades to black, then transitions to the cover of the Cosmogony

CHOICE.Shiva: The Six have safeguarded this star since time immemorial—each of a different mind, but united by this common purpose.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions to an image of Shiva freezing some humans to death in a blizzard

CHOICE.Shiva: The gods' protection extends to all creatures here below—even to the mortals created in their image. They are feeble creatures leading fragile lives and clinging to foolish fancies. The Frostbearer scorns these visions of "hope" which melt like snow in the sun's light.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions to an image of Ifrit lighting a fire in front of a gathering of humans

CHOICE.Shiva: Yet the Pyreburner admires their strength of will. For their reverence, he grants unto them his flame, and the world of man flourishes.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions to an image of Ifrit and Shiva floating in the sky locked in a loving embrace

CHOICE.Shiva: His benevolence warms the heart of the Frostbearer.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions to an image of the lofty spires of a technologically advanced human settlement; an airship is flying across the sky in the image

CHOICE.Shiva: It is not long, however, before some among those men ascend to new heights of hubris. The people of Solheim spurn the gods who blessed them—the gods they once worshipped.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions to an image of an enraged Ifrit casting fire down upon fleeing humans

CHOICE.Shiva: The ungrateful mortals incur the wrath of the Pyreburner. He seeks to raze the very civilization his flames once helped build.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions back to Shiva speaking to Noctis

CHOICE.Shiva: But the Six are sworn to defend the star and all its inhabitants from harm—and, at times, from one another.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions to an image of the other five gods confronting Ifrit; a number of other divine entities are also present for the battle, some seemingly allied with Ifrit

CHOICE.Shiva: The flames of war surge as Solheim fends off the Pyreburner's fire. The gods' pleas for peace fall on deaf ears, and the battle rages on. When the smoke clears, the world of man is in ruins, their star left scarred for time eternal. Wearied from war, the Six seek solace in slumber.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene fades to black as Shiva continues to speak

CHOICE.Shiva: This tale of our shared past is entrusted to the King of Kings...

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene fades back in on Shiva and Noctis

CHOICE.Shiva: ... that he may see it to its conclusion.

CHOICE.SYSTEM: Ask about hopes for the future

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene briefly fades to black, then transitions to an image of Ifrit rising to his feet at the Rock of Ravatogh; parts of his body are glowing with deformity

CHOICE.Shiva: In the days that follow the war, while the Six are still asleep, the Pyreburner is sought by a man who draws him away from the Light.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions to an image of Shiva swarmed by imperial dreadnaughts and drop ships

CHOICE.Shiva: His peril is sensed by the Frostbearer. She rushes to his aid, only to be felled by the foreign hordes.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions to daemons flying over Gralea as explosions rock the city

CHOICE.Shiva: Those masses are now one with the darkness—darkness that, before long, will swallow the Six and the star they protect.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene fades to black as Shiva continues to speak

CHOICE.Shiva: This star's fate no longer rests in the hands of the gods. It sits on the shoulders of the Chosen.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene fades back in on Shiva and Noctis

CHOICE.Shiva: Deliver this world from darkness—and grant my love release.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The dialogue picks up with Shiva's next line below

text.Shiva: The Oracle is no longer of this world, but her thoughts remain—and they must be known.

text.NARRATIVE: A prompt appears to select either "Ask about Luna's thoughts" or "Receive her blessing"

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene briefly fades to black, then transitions to footage from the FFXV "Dawn" trailer of five-year-old Noctis in his father's arms

CHOICE.Shiva: When the boy begins his existence on this star, the girl is met by the High Messenger.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions to an image of eight-year-old Noctis and 12-year-old Luna looking at their notebook together

CHOICE.Shiva: It is ordained that she will work with him to return the Light. The girl reaffirms that promise.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The scene transitions to an image of Gentiana conversing with 12-year-old Luna

CHOICE.Shiva: The High Messenger is moved by the girl's determination, her heart warmed by the girl's benevolence. Her faith in mankind is restored once more.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: A flashback of Lunafreya and Ravus in the field of sylleblossoms at Tenebrae is now shown; her back is to him

CHOICE.Ravus: Sister, cease this madness. That boy will never be King.

CHOICE.Luna: Noctis is chosen. It is ordained. You of all people should know.

CHOICE.Ravus: I know that you are throwing your life away!

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Lunafreya turns and shouts back at her brother

CHOICE.Luna: That may be! But... it's my choice. If only...

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Lunafreya begins to cry

CHOICE.Luna: If only I could... hear his voice once more... If we could laugh together as we did as children...

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: She grips her hands together and continues to cry

CHOICE.Luna: If we could... live out our days together as we once dreamed...

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Gentiana suddenly addresses her

CHOICE.Luna: Forgive me. I vowed to only cry where prying eyes cannot see the tears in mine.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: The camera pans to show Gentiana standing before Luna

CHOICE.Gentiana: Yet others need not hide their grief. Is she so different from them?

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Lunafreya shakes her head

CHOICE.Luna: No... She is no different at all. She wants exactly what they do: to be with the one she loves. But want though she may, it is not to be.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Gentiana walks up to her

CHOICE.Gentiana: The lady's thoughts have been heard. The love she bears the king shall never fade—and, in time, her feelings shall be known unto him.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Gentiana wipes away a tear from Luna's left eye as she says the last few words of the previous line; Luna cries more

CHOICE.Luna: Gentiana...

CHOICE.Gentiana: And if the words are not spoken from her lips, then the Messengers shall see that they are heard. The gods' favor and the lady's love shall be with him evermore.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Gentiana smiles at her, then takes Luna's hand with one of her own and places her other on Luna's upturned palm

CHOICE.Gentiana: Thus it is promised between the Oracle and her familiar.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Luna composes herself and takes hold of Gentiana's hands with both of her own

CHOICE.Luna: I am undeserving of your kindness... Thank you.

CHOICE.NARRATIVE: Luna smiles at her; Gentiana smiles back and a single tear streaks down Gentiana's cheek; the scene transitions back to Shiva and Noctis
The dialogue picks up with Shiva's next line below

text.Shiva: And so the promise is fulfilled. As her words go with him, so shall my blessing.

text.NARRATIVE: She raises her hands and conjures Lunafreya's trident; she hands it to Noctis; he leans forward and grasps it

text.Shiva: O King of Kings, restore the Light unto this world.

text.NARRATIVE: The two are enveloped in a flash of light; several glimpses are shown of eight-year-old Noctis and 12-year-old Lunafreya, then of her recent departure from Eos as an adult

text.Luna: Farewell, dear Noctis.

text.NARRATIVE: The scene fades to white for a moment before fading back to Noctis on the train in the present; Shiva is gone, as is the blizzard that was enveloping the train car; Luna's trident is still in Noctis's hand, but it quickly dissipates

text.Noctis: Luna... I'm sorry... I'm sorry I couldn't be there for you. Not even when you needed me most.

text.NARRATIVE: He begins to cry

text.Noctis: There was so much you wanted to say. So much I wanted to say... And now I'll never have the chance. I'm so sorry...

text.NARRATIVE: He then notices the sudden light emanating from spectral sylleblossom petals as they float down toward him; Noct slowly rises to his knees as his eyes move up, seeing first her feet, then a spectral image of Lunafreya herself; she smiles at him; he reaches out to touch her, but just as he's about to, she vanishes; Noctis falls forward; the last of the sylleblossom petals floats into his open palm; he lifts himself back to his knees; he closes his hand around it, pulls his hand to his chest and begins to cry once more; in another brief flash of white, Noct briefly flashbacks to when he and Lunafreya were together as children again

text.Luna: I know you won't.

text.NARRATIVE: With another brief flash, Noct is back in the present

text.Noctis: Luna... You and I will be together again someday. I promise.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis rises back to his feet and brushes away his tears

text.SYSTEM: Trident of the Oracle x 1
Mark of the Glacian x 1

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis walks up to the frozen Ardyn, conjures the Trident of the Oracle, and shatters the imperial chancellor's frozen body with Lunafreya's weapon
Noct then loses his balance and stumbles to his downed friends
They begin to stir

text.Gladiolus: The hell happened?

text.Noctis: Yeah. I saw the Glacian. It's okay, she's gone now. You guys check on our drivers.

text.Gladiolus: Got it.

text.NARRATIVE: Gladio turns to Ignis and places his hand on his shoulder

text.Gladiolus: You good?

text.Ignis: Yes, I'm fine. Let's go.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis remains on the floor for a moment as they leave before the scene briefly fades to black; when it fades back in, Noct is standing once again; now back on his feet, he makes his way through the next train car, where he realizes he's not alone; he turns to find Ardyn standing a few feet away

text.Ardyn: I feel I've earned the right to call you Noct. For a moment I felt death's chill wind, such is the might of the gods. But then, I remembered I'm immortal. Such is my blessing and curse. Your attack hurt me, nevertheless...

text.NARRATIVE: He suddenly scowls fiercely at Noct, and his voice becomes something of a growl

text.Ardyn: My feelings at least.

text.NARRATIVE: He's quite for a moment

text.Ardyn: And after all the memories we've shared. Remember this?

text.NARRATIVE: Ardyn raises one of Prompto's guns, pointing it at Noctis

text.Ardyn: Ah, I should have asked if you remember him. Truly a blast from the past, nay?

text.NARRATIVE: Ardyn casually walks up to Noctis and places the side of the gun against Noctis's chest; Noct tries to grab it, but Ardyn pulls it away and turns away

text.Ardyn: Ah, ah, ah! You mustn't take what's not yours.
"He"?

text.NARRATIVE: Ardyn turns back to face Noct

text.Ardyn: The little gunman's a short shot away.

text.NARRATIVE: Ardyn raises his finger and points

text.Ardyn: Where else but Gralea, the seat of the empire? I'm sure he'll be delighted to see you. And you might even find your Crystal. With all these daemons about, you could certainly use it.

text.NARRATIVE: Ardyn walks past Noctis, deliberately pushing past him as he does so, then comes to a stop

text.Ardyn: Off you go, then. I wouldn't want to keep you from your friend.

text.NARRATIVE: Ardyn raises his rand hand, in which he is holding a small device; he presses a button on the device with his thumb, then leaves without another word; Noctis stares after Ardyn, gritting his teeth

text.SYSTEM: Having stolen Noctis's country, Crystal, and cherished companions, Ardyn waits implacably in Gralea.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis, Ignis and Gladio are sitting in the dining car of the train as it heads for Gralea

text.Ignis: We should be drawing close to Gralea.

text.Gladiolus: I can't imagine what it'll be like.

text.Noctis: Swarming with daemons, but you knew that.

text.Gladiolus: Don't remind me.

text.Ignis: Once we arrive, we'll make for the Keep.
Zegnautus. An imperial megafortress said to be impregnable.

text.Noctis: With Prompto and the Crystal inside it.

text.Gladiolus: What goes in, must come out.

text.NARRATIVE: The three are silent for a moment

text.Gladiolus: So, are we buying this story that the Crystal can purge daemons?

text.Ignis: The proof is in the purging, but it does stand to reason. We've observed that as the nights have grown longer, the daemon hordes have grown stronger. If they are in fact averse to the Crystal's Light, it could save not only Lucis, but the world.

text.Noctis: We'll find out once we take it back.

text.NARRATIVE: Suddenly, the train comes screeching to a halt

text.Gladiolus: The hell?

text.Ignis: What is it?

text.Gladiolus: My guess? Something to sidetrack us.

text.NARRATIVE: The three get up and move into the cabin car; as they walk past the series of large windows here, they all suddenly crack and the train car shakes

text.Gladiolus: What now?

text.NARRATIVE: Biggs speaks to the three over the loudspeaker

text.Biggs: City's trying to keep us out... with the daemons.

text.NARRATIVE: Small imp-like daemons, called snaga, begin swarming across the windows

text.Gladiolus: Whoa-whoa.

text.NARRATIVE: Biggs speaks over the loudspeaker again

text.Biggs: Gotta run! Don't worry about us.

text.NARRATIVE: One of the daemons busts through the glass and lands in front of Noctis and the others; he holds out his hand to tell Gladiolus to move back, then attempts to conjure a weapon into his hand
Noctis looks at his hand, confused

text.Gladiolus: What's wrong?
Get back!

text.NARRATIVE: Gladiolus pulls Noctis away from the now charging daemon and kicks it in the face

text.Ignis: Run!

text.NARRATIVE: As Ignis retreats, Gladio pats Noct's shoulder

text.Gladiolus: C'mon, move it!

text.NARRATIVE: The following notification appears

text.SYSTEM: "Ardyn has stripped Noctis of his weapons.
Flee to the freight car at the back of the train.
The ability to call Umbra is also unavailable."]

text.Ignis: Only a matter of time before we run out of room to run!
We trade the train for the Regalia!

text.Gladiolus: C'mon!

text.Ignis: Noct! The freight car!

text.NARRATIVE: The trio make it to the Regalia; Noct gets into the driver's seat while Gladio gets in the passenger's seat and Ignis in the back

text.Gladiolus: Gun it!

text.NARRATIVE: Noct drives the Regalia out of the freight car and out onto the train tracks; an automated message then rings out

text.Announcement: Threat upgraded. Activating level 4 security measures. Sealing all gates.

text.NARRATIVE: The following notification appears

text.SYSTEM: "The city's defense system has begun sealing all entrances.
Make it into Gralea before the gate closes!
R2 Accelerate
L2 Brake/Reverse"]

text.Gladiolus: Put the pedal to the metal!
Don't crash!

text.Ignis: Where are we now!?

text.Noctis: inside a tunnel—on the train tracks!

text.Gladiolus: Don't slow down, or they'll catch us up!

text.Noctis: Going as fast as I can—hang on!

text.NARRATIVE: Noct drives the car through the tunnel and onto a tracks bridge in the city proper; as the royal retinue races down the bridge, an artillery shell suddenly strikes near the car, causing a small explosion

text.Ignis: What was that!?

text.Noctis: They're trying to blow us off the tracks.

text.NARRATIVE: Artillery continues striking around the Regalia

text.Gladiolus: One clean hit and it's over.

text.Ignis: It'll take a bit more than that to stop His Majesty's trusty steed.

text.NARRATIVE: The artillery strikes begin hitting their mark; an imperial drop ship can then be seen falling out of the sky

text.Gladiolus: Dodging one thing to run into another.

text.Ignis: The Regalia can take the punishment. Just focus on your driving.

text.NARRATIVE: More artillery strikes the Regalia; the vehicle is now on fire

text.Noctis: You can do it, girl. You can get through this.

text.NARRATIVE: As the Regalia closes in on the gate, several more strikes land directly on the car

text.Gladiolus: It's closing! Floor it!

text.NARRATIVE: Just as the Regalia makes it through the rapidly closing gate, another strike lands square on the royal contraption, briefly engulfing it in flame; Noct brings the car to a screeching halt on the other side of the gate near the debris of a train car that stretches across the width of the bridge, one end propped up above the tracks; the Regalia now sits sizzling on the tracks, all its windows shattered; it has taken its final run

text.Gladiolus: That's all she's got.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct, Ignis and Gladio get out of the car and begin to walk away; Noct turns to look back at the car with a somber expression, recalling a memory from childhood of his father stepping out of the car and embracing him
After a moment, Gladiolus speaks up

text.Gladiolus: Are we seriously marching into the capital empty-handed?

text.Ignis: And with no assurances the Crystal can beat back the daemon hordes.

text.Gladiolus: Guess we'll find out the hard way. No turning back now, right?
This thing could come down at any time...

text.Ignis: Let's be quick.

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis makes his way under the wreckage, but before Gladio and Ignis can follow, the train car collapses, separating the latter two from their charge
Ardyn begins broadcasting his voice to Noctis

text.Ardyn: Look at you. All by your lonesome.

text.Noctis: You again. You know, for an imperial chancellor, you are one sick son of a bitch.

text.NARRATIVE: Daemons begin emerging and attempting to swarm Noctis
Noct addresses Ardyn

text.Noctis: The hell do you want? Leave me alone! This is getting out of hand.

text.NARRATIVE: Noct manges to make it into a now derelict building where he stops to catch his breath; after a moment, he drops to one knee, reaches into his pocket and pulls out something clenched in his fist; he slowly opens his palm to reveal the Ring of the Lucii; Noct's hands begin to shake as he stares at it and he grunts rapidly, as though wracked with pain; continuing to shake and grunt, he unsteadily slides the ring onto his finger, roaring in pain and his eyes briefly glowing red as he succeeds in this struggle; catching his breath once again, Noctis stares at the ring of his ancestors, flexes his hand, and rises from his knees
A notification appears saying "Harbored within the Ring of the Lucii, arcana encompasses three powerful spells. The first of these is Death, which drains a foe's life force to restore your own."
A snaga falls from above, lands in front of Noctis, and comes at him

text.Noctis: How did they get in here?

text.NARRATIVE: After killing the snaga and making his forward, Noctis gets a good look at an illuminated cylindrical structure connected to the bottom of the floating Zegnautus Keep

text.Noctis: Looks like it's connected below. Might be my ticket to the top.

text.NARRATIVE: In this area are doors Noctis can't immediately get through

Noct finds a generator in the area; activating unlocks one of the doors that wouldn't open; a notification appears saying "Find switches to power up doors and elevators in order to continue on to Zegnautus Keep, where the Crystal is being held."
A notification appears saying "Save manually at dormitories located throughout Gralea and Zegnautus Keep."

text.Noctis: Should be safe to rest here.

text.NARRATIVE: While making his way across the rooftop of one of the abandoned buildings, Noct is attacked by four snaga at once, prompting the reveal of the second arcana spell; a notification appears saying "A spell of the arcana, Alterna consigns entire hordes of enemies to the void at the cost of all MP."

text.Noctis: That's the way to the elevator taken care of.

text.NARRATIVE: As Noctis makes for the Keep, the third arcana spell makes itself known; a notification appears saying "A spell of the arcana, Holy counters with a blast of sacred light when evading, making it effective against melee enemies."

text.Noctis: Dead quiet. Where did everybody go?

text.NARRATIVE: When Noct approaches the elevator, its doors open, revealing more daemons
The doors close and the elevator begins to ascend toward Zegnautus Keep above

text.Noctis: This whole city gives me the chills.

text.NARRATIVE: Ardyn broadcasts his voice to Noctis once again

text.Ardyn: How does it feel to be powerless? Can't help your friends if you can't help yourself.

text.Noctis: Gotta hurry and find them. Wherever they are.

text.Ardyn: Can't you simply taste the air of foreboding?

text.NARRATIVE: When rounding one corner, Ardyn can be seen at the other end of the hall walking away from a downed magitek trooper that suddenly stands, taking a zombie-like posture

text.SYSTEM: Rogue axemen patrol along a set route.
Hiding from rogue axemen allows you to avoid conflict and recover MP.

text.Noctis: These don't look like typical MTs.

text.SYSTEM: Noctis cannot operate doors and devices while the enemy is aware of his presence. End the state of conflict by taking out all hostiles or simply leaving the area.

text.Ardyn: Must be tiring, having to run all the time.
That magic is a royal disappointment.

text.NARRATIVE: As Noct walks past a gated-off hallway, one of the zombie-like magitek troopers suddenly reaches through the bars and grabs him; he manages to break the MT's group and it falls backward on the floor in a disheveled heap
Checking a lounge area, Noctis finds an empty uniform laying on the floor with a cardkey

text.Noctis: Missed some streaker running around here?

text.SYSTEM: Security Card x 1

text.NARRATIVE: Now possessing the cardkey, Noct is able to open a door at the opposite end of the hallway leading to the lounge; while walking across the bridge this door blocked access to, Ardyn can be heard laughing

text.Ardyn: It's all coming along swimmingly, isn't it?

text.Noctis: Can't afford to get spun around.

text.NARRATIVE: As Noct rounds a corner after making the statement above, he sees what appears to be Prompto run down the hall in the opposite direction
In one of the Keep's rooms, Noct finds a machine that upgrades one's security clearance

text.Noctis: What have we here? "Clearance level"? Nice.

text.SYSTEM: Card security clearance raised to level 2.

text.NARRATIVE: An automated message rings out

text.Announcement: Security clearance raised to level 2. Access to level 2 zones authorized.

text.NARRATIVE: Making his way down more hallways he can now access, Noct continues catching sight of what appears to be Prompto going the other way

text.Ardyn: Poor Prompto must be feeling the heat right about now.

text.NARRATIVE: Very soon after Ardyn's comment, Noct comes to a gated-off room with what appears to be Prompto sitting slumped over in a chair inside

Making his way to a nearby storage room, Noctis finds a narrow passageway leading into the room where Prompto appears to be; Noctis begins squeezing his way through; while doing so, he hears Prompto's voice

text.Prompto: Noct! Help me!

text.NARRATIVE: Noctis makes it into the other room and is immediately beset by an uttu daemon and two rogue axemen

After killing his attackers, Noct squeezes between some stacked crates to find "Prompto"; when he touches him, however, Ardyn's illusion is lifted, and "Prompto" is revealed to be a dead magitek trooper, which falls out of the chair

text.Noctis: Another trick! Back to square one...

text.NARRATIVE: In the same room, Noct is able to update his security card

text.SYSTEM: Card security clearance raised to level 3.

text.NARRATIVE: An automated message rings out

text.Announcement: Security clearance raised to level 3. Access to level 3 zones authorized.

text.NARRATIVE: As Noctis proceeds, Ardyn's voice returns to taunt him once more

text.Ardyn: Oh, you should have seen the look on your face
